characters.summary: Darth Vader is a cybernetic Sith Lord who relies on overwhelming physical strength, telekinesis, and a relentless lightsaber combat style. He absorbs attacks using his suit and breaks enemies mentally and physically through sheer force projection.

mechanisms: Heavy cybernetic armor resistant to glancing blows

weaknesses: Critical reliance on suit life support systems
Vulnerability to intense electrical discharges such as Force lightning
limitations: Reduced agility and flexibility due to heavy cybernetic suit

sources.supports: Abilities, cybernetic suit, weaknesses, and Force powers.

feats.claim: Rips a doorway apart and pulls opponents with the Force.
feats.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
notableResults.note: Kenobi allowed himself to be struck down to enable escape.

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
notableResults.note: Defeated when Luke surrendered to anger and overwhelmed him.

characters.summary: Representing a hypothetical fully restored Vader without suit limitations, this variant combines immense raw Force potential with unrestricted physical mobility.
characters.formDifferences: Removes the cybernetic suit limitations, granting full biological movement and eliminating the critical life-support weakness.
